post.summary: Atomically submit outbox operations and pull a page of changes

200.description: Success

post.description: Request limit 2 MiB; at most 50 operations. All validated and committed together. Identical retries replay their original result. Stale revisions append a conflict candidate, including stale writes after deletion; current baseRevision explicitly resolves all candidates. More than 16 candidates, future revisions/cursors, or changed operation-ID content return 409 and roll back the entire batch. Each account has independent monotonic cursors. Pull at most 100 changes, repeat with returned cursor while hasMore. Never advance cursor to an operation result revision. Tombstones and retry history do not expire in v1.

200.description: Current account privacy; stale writes have accepted=false

token.description: Opaque bearer token. Returned once; store in OS credential storage.

inLibrary.description: Personal library membership. False for shared browsing until explicitly added; omitted values retain existing membership or default to personal.

completedChapter.description: Optional completed chapter number from a validated numbered table of contents.

currentChapter.description: Optional current chapter number at the saved reading location, used for external chapter tracking.

recordId.description: default for book/position; stable annotation ID otherwise.

Operation.description: Maximum 32 KiB encoded value. Value schema must match kind. Deleted operations omit value or use null. New records use baseRevision 0. Device timestamps are deliberately excluded. Operation IDs must not be reused for different content.
